Dual Counter-rotating Roller Unit.name: Steel Ingots
Dual Counter-rotating Roller Unit.reasoning: Primary material for the rollers and shafts providing mechanical strength and durability; steel is industry standard for rollers due to hardness and wear resistance.

Dual Counter-rotating Roller Unit.name: Stainless steel (SS 316)
Dual Counter-rotating Roller Unit.reasoning: Used for corrosion resistance and wear surface on rollers; common stainless steel grade in food and pharmaceutical machinery rollers.

Dual Counter-rotating Roller Unit.name: Carbon
Dual Counter-rotating Roller Unit.reasoning: Elemental constituent in steel that affects hardness and wear; critical in defining roller material properties.

Dual Counter-rotating Roller Unit.name: Ceramic
Dual Counter-rotating Roller Unit.reasoning: Sometimes used as surface coatings or inserts in roller units for wear resistance; less common but important as an alternative.

Twin Roll Compaction Unit.name: Stainless steel (SS 316)
Twin Roll Compaction Unit.reasoning: Used for surfaces in direct contact with powder to avoid corrosion and contamination, especially in pharmaceutical applications.

Twin Roll Compaction Unit.name: Carbon
Twin Roll Compaction Unit.reasoning: Key constituent of steel providing hardness; important for compaction roller effectiveness.

Twin Roll Compaction Unit.name: Ceramic
Twin Roll Compaction Unit.reasoning: Used occasionally as coatings for wear resistance; alternatives exist but steel remains dominant.

Powder Feeding System.name: Aluminum
Powder Feeding System.reasoning: Used in non-contact structural parts for lightweight and machinability; sometimes used when corrosion environment is mild.

Drive System (motors And Gearbox).name: Steel Ingots

Compression Roll Drive System.name: Steel Ingots

Compression Roll Drive System.name: Stainless steel (SS 316)
Compression Roll Drive System.reasoning: Used for corrosion resistance and enhanced wear surfaces on drive components; standard in food/pharma equipment.

Compression Roll Drive System.name: Carbon
Compression Roll Drive System.reasoning: Important element in steel contributing to mechanical properties; moderately confident due to variations in steel grades.
